$comment: Machine-executable allowlist for the precise ACL-removal scan (scripts/acl_scan.py). Categories are matched in listed order; active_code hits must additionally match one of allowed_line_patterns (regex). Every change here must land in the same commit as the code/docs it describes.

scan_tooling.$comment: The scanner, its allowlist, and its precision test quote ACL identifiers in order to detect them; they are not ACL capabilities.

categories.rationale: Frozen request datasets that compare legacy vs target contract behavior.
Tests and evals asserting the removed ACL names stay absent.
Removal/migration documentation and historical audit archives.

categories.$comment: Frozen pre-removal runtime output archives kept as historical evidence. Every file is enumerated exactly (no directory glob): a new file appearing in run_results/, examples/, or inputs/ with an ACL token is a violation, and these entries must never be widened.
categories.rationale: Historical runtime outputs captured before the ACL removal; read-only evidence, not active code.

active_code.rationale: Active runtime may only carry the versioned audit epoch historical identifier; any other ACL reference is a violation.
